changelog.description: Business mode system with .biz command for quick toggle
Smart auto-reply with AI learning and keyword matching
Advanced anti-ban system with human-like behavior patterns
Interactive trivia game with 50+ questions and leaderboards
Daily and weekly group challenges system
Free API integrations (news, jokes, facts, horoscope)
Business analytics dashboard
Smart notification and alert system
Version management with rollback support
Context-aware menus (.start, .menu)
Puter.js AI as primary provider with multi-provider fallback
Conversation memory with user profiles
Product catalog and invoice generation
Multi-language translation (60+ languages)
Image generation with free AI providers
Broken imports in stickerConverter and webp2mp4
Removed hardcoded admin password from security.js
Menu command now uses cached commands instead of reloading
Broadcast command now has rate limiting
Cleanup system now initializes on bot startup
Replaced src/ directory with root-level code
Removed unnecessary files and dead code
Sharp and node-webpmux dependencies (replaced with ffmpeg)
